test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

I said to her, "What brought you here?"

options.text: I asked her what had brought her there.
I asked her what had brought her here.
I asked her that what brought her here.
I asked her what brought her there.

solution:
The correct answer is '**I asked her what had brought her there.**'
